children: France's 2027 budget will include a 54 billion euro ($62 billion) savings drive without which the fiscal deficit would otherwise exceed over 6.5% of economic output, Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu told Le Figaro newspaper on Thursday.

Without corrective action, social welfare spending would rise 22 billion euros while debt servicing costs were expected to increase an additional 10 billion euros, Lecornu said. Local government spending would also rise 7 billion euros if nothing is done.
